upstream_calibration.interpretation: post-outcome development input only; these immutable inputs motivate the new design but are not reclassified or reused as fresh evidence

candidate_stream.world_seed_rule: sha256(world_seed_namespace + ':' + decimal_candidate_index), first 8 bytes big-endian, mask to 63 bits
candidate_stream.collision_exclusions: all seeds in the bound historical registry and the fully retired utilization-feasibility-v1 namespace; zero collisions in the frozen v2 0..1023 vector

target_free_plan_barrier.post_review_scan_authorization: scan CLI and build_scan_shard require the exact independently reviewed plan_sha256 as a separate explicit argument

development_target_materialization.target_seed_rule: sha256(target_seed_namespace + ':target:' + decimal_world_seed), full 32-byte digest interpreted as one big-endian integer
development_target_materialization.target_selection_rule: after the reviewed plan barrier, call existing generate_spark_world(world_seed, target_seed) exactly once; its existing random.Random(target_seed).randrange(256) selects the sole target

context_universe.candidate_rule: every member of the frozen target-independent motif library in ascending motif_id order

action_universe.raw_action_index_rule: five frames in frozen order for path [1,1], followed by the same five frames for path [1,2]

endpoint.name: K4_full_pool
endpoint.replacement_pool: all structurally valid same-parent, same-frame, same-stratum, same-complexity matched replacements from the frozen motif library whose complete-domain behavior differs from the focal child
endpoint.nonconstant_child_definition: the complete-domain binary behavior contains both 0 and 1

opportunity_creation_census.question: within one fixed world and action universe, how does changing only the candidate context change reachable K2 and nonconstant K4 raw-action sets
opportunity_creation_census.context_pair_universe: all unordered behavior-distinct motif pairs with the same stratum and complexity bucket
pair_change_outputs: K1 raw-action-set equality and symmetric-difference size
K2 raw-action-set equality and symmetric-difference size
nonconstant K4 raw-action-set equality and symmetric-difference size
opportunity_creation_census.interpretation: a deterministic census of the constructed finite DSL landscape, not model discovery and not confirmatory evidence

tiers.future_claim_limit: may support context-responsive unique-action switching only after a separately frozen masked model experiment
at most context-responsive disjoint-set utilization; it cannot inherit the unique-action switching label

cohort_feasibility.matching_graph: one bipartite graph from eligible worlds to pair motif strata; each world has capacity 1 and each selected stratum has exact capacity q
cohort_feasibility.world_assignment_tie_break: for each motif stratum in frozen order sort assigned candidate indices ascending, concatenate the four lists, and choose the lexicographically smallest jointly feasible vector
cohort_feasibility.within_world_pair_order: ascending canonical tuple of tier priority, stratum, context A motif_id, context B motif_id, and correct raw-action lists
selection_forbidden_fields: compressor N_T magnitude after endpoint classification
control-pool size above the frozen minimum
geometry_outputs: maximum exact stratum-balanced q under the cap
target-q feasibility, fallback-q feasibility, and selected q reported separately
candidate capacity by tier, stratum and unordered correct-raw set pair
correct raw, path and frame marginals
child behavior and full-pool bundle diversity
cohort_feasibility.display_position_and_condition_order: not assigned by this feasibility scan; they must be hard-counterbalanced in the later masked benchmark after prospective power

scan_and_merge_contract.evaluation_order: candidate_index, then motif_id, then raw_action_index, all ascending

artifact_contract.interpretation_limit: constructs and audits an outcome-conditioned finite-DSL development geometry; it does not test model utilization, estimate natural-world creation prevalence, alter prior formal results, establish a model ranking, or imply human-unknown discovery
